title: tool_cb_hdr: suppress header output when --out-null
body:
Prior to this change curl did not suppress the header output from --head when --out-null was used to suppress output.

Reported-by: Andrew Kvalheim

Fixes https://github.com/curl/curl/discussions/20235
Closes #xxxx
